TypeScript, React Native Paper UI, react-hook-form with yup validation, Redux integration (mocked), Biometric authentication setup (mocked), Error handling, Loading states, Navigation to LoginScreen, Responsive design with ScrollView and useTheme.

- Loading states (submit button disabled and shows spinner when loading)
- Navigation (uses `useNavigation` and `Appbar.BackAction` to go back/navigate to Login)
